_comment: Oracle compounds for Rett syndrome validation. Each pathway lists expected approved drugs (by ChEMBL ID + name) and the target genes that define membership. Used by tests/test_validation.py — see IMPLEMENTATION_BRIEF.md §14.

IGF-1 axis.notes: Trofinetide (Daybue, FDA-approved 2023) is the canonical Rett-specific IGF-1 analog, but is not currently in Open Targets' approved-drugs graph for Rett — Mecasermin (recombinant IGF-1) covers the same axis.

BDNF / TrkB signaling.notes: No approved drug hits BDNF or TrkB for Rett in Open Targets. Investigational compounds (LM22A-4, 7,8-DHF) are not in scope for the approved-drugs filter. This pathway is therefore expected to fail coverage in Phase 1; the test relaxes to ≥3 of 4 pathways.

Sigma-1 receptor.notes: Dextromethorphan is dual-acting (NMDA + sigma-1). Its canonical target in our pipeline is GRIN2A; SIGMAR1 appears in alternative_targets evidence.
